rationale: Ahmad is architecting AI-native hardware at Midjourney after leading Vision Pro's hardware engineering, while Anders is building developer tooling and coding agents optimized for open source models—both are betting on deeply integrated AI systems rather than bolt-on solutions. Ahmad's conviction that AI hardware must be tightly coupled with generative models aligns with Anders' focus on AI-native automation, and Anders' fractional CTO advising experience could offer valuable product/technical perspective as Ahmad pioneers a novel hardware category beyond wearables.
intro_message: Ahmad Abbas, meet Anders Lie — you're both in San Francisco building the next wave of AI integration (hardware vs. developer tooling), and Anders' experience scaling AI-native products and advising early-stage teams could complement your push into uncharted hardware form factors.
